adverse_history.finding: The first packaging harness renamed the title and therefore failed text and raster equivalence despite matching mathematical components and link counts.
adverse_history.disposition: The harness title was restored byte-for-text to the sealed producer title, the deterministic ZIP was rebuilt under a new identity, and the full isolated replay then passed.

claim_boundary: This proves custody-package integrity and isolated reproduction of the sealed bounded reader. It is not a complete EGA IV, critical-edition, peer-review, accessibility, or rights-clearance claim.
